thread:
tara: FYI we started seeing a spike in embedding 413s after a customer upgraded their client. Root cause looks like mixed-dim vectors in a single request where our preflight accepted it but the shard runtime choked.

nate: can you paste the failing request?

tara: heres a sanitized excerpt: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $T' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"model\":\"open-vec-512\", \"input\":[[...512...],[...2048...],[...512...]]}'

jo: if the model is open-vec-512 and one vector is 2048 that's already a mismatch. But odd that preflight returned 200. Our estimator only accounts for byte size when the client doesn't supply a dim hint, so mixed dims sneak through.

anya: we should treat this as both an API UX and an ops problem. For users we can: (A) return structured preflight errors with a clear code and suggestions, (B) teach the console/request inspector to show "mixed dims detected" and offer remediation, (C) nudge SDKs to send per-vector dims header.

chris: +1. For (A) propose preflight 422 with body: {"code":"mixed_dims","detected_dims":[512,2048],"suggestions":["add X-Vector-Dim","use SDK >=0.10","enable console auto-split"]}. That gives clients something machine-readable.

nate: operationally we also need short-term mitigation: runtime currently returns 413 which is ambiguous. We can change 413 body to include a hint string immediately while we work on preflight.

tara: good call. What about automatic ingress split when dim hint is absent? That would avoid breaks but may increase per-request CPU and memory churn and could interfere with batching density.

jo: runtime can support two modes: a cheap detect-and-fastfail path, and a heavy auto-split path. We can gate auto-split behind a feature flag per-cluster and per-tenant and run it as a tiny canary. The detect-only preflight + 422 is low-risk and should be first.

anya: telemetry plan: emit event "ingress.embed.oversize.v2" with tags: dims_present (y/n), max_dim, num_vectors, request_bytes, outcome (preflight_422/runtime_413/accepted/auto_split). Hook it into the console so tenants see counts.

infra-bot: created ticket PERF-5901: "embeds: mixed-dim preflight + telemetry + console hints" and assigned to eng-platform.

chris: rollout plan idea:
- day 0-1: return improved 413 body with hint and ship telemetry event (ingress.embed.oversize.v2).
- day 2-4: introduce preflight 422 with structured JSON and update SDKs doc.
- week 1-2: console: show per-request inspector hint + quick action "enable auto-split for tenant" which flips a per-tenant feature flag.
- week 2-4: gated runtime auto-split behind feature flag: 0.1% tenants -> 1% -> 10% with KPIs.

tara: which KPIs do we monitor to rollback if things regress?

jo: keep it simple: embedding 413 rate, embedding request p50/p95 latency, node CPU usage, batch fill-rate (tokens per batch), and error spike counts. If auto-split causes batch fill-rate to drop or CPU to exceed threshold, auto-disable on that node.

nate: add one more safety: when auto-split increases cost per request beyond a threshold (we'll define a cost delta), mark the tenant and alert product so we can discuss billing/limits.

anya: console UX ask: product wants the tenant toggle to show an estimated impact panel: expected changes to error rate, latency delta, and cost delta, computed from sampled telemetry. Will need a backend endpoint to simulate the split for a sample of recent requests.

chris: ops runbook stub: how to flip per-tenant flag, how to disable auto-split cluster-wide, and a quick query for recent 422/413s by tenant. I'll add that under PERF-5901.

tara: SDKs: I'll file a follow-up to ensure server SDKs start sending X-Vector-Dims in the next release and to add client-side validation warnings. Also add example code in the console inspector.

nate: consensus seems to be: ship better 413 body + telemetry ASAP, add 422 preflight for mixed dims, console hint + tenant toggle, then gated auto-split with monitoring and kill-switches.

anya: leaving action items: 1) chris: PR for telemetry + 413 body. 2) jo: preflight 422 implementation. 3) tara: console mock + inspector copy. 4) nate: rollout plan + KPIs dashboard. I'll coordinate with product for the impact panel.

infra-bot: added runbook "embeds-ingress-auto-split.md" to PERF-5901.

tara: thanks team. I'll open a short RFC to capture decisions and timeline.
